title: Orbit Arcade
description: A bold lilac, acid-yellow, and tangerine cosmic playground: a procedural-textured Three.js solar system with eight selectable planet postcards, animated stylized orbits, orbit/zoom controls, pause/resume, adjustable time, reset, overhead view, and close-up tracking.

tests.name: JavaScript syntax
tests.outcome: Passed before and after the source repair; exit code 0.

tests.name: Local Vite production bundle with no output writes
tests.outcome: Passed before and after the source repair; exit code 0. Final Vite 7.3.6 bundle transformed 7 modules and returned index.html (5816 characters), JavaScript (580803 characters), and CSS (18853 characters) in memory. No bundle files were written.

repairsMade: Corrected the custom Sun shader's include directives to start on separate lines; inline directives would not be resolved as GLSL preprocessor directives. Reran both prescribed checks successfully.
Removed a redundant optional lookup for a nonexistent profile-card ID; the actual profile-card class lookup is retained.
knownLimitations: Browser localhost access was unavailable as specified. No browser, screenshot, GPU shader compilation, or live interaction checks were performed or claimed.

Planet sizes, orbital distances, motion rates, textures, and colors are expressive stylizations, clearly labelled in the interface. Approximate orbital years are reference facts rather than simulation timing.
WebGL-unavailable and context-loss states show an explanatory fallback and retain HTML planet-profile selection; recovery from context loss requires a page reload.
Reduced-motion preferences start the simulation paused and suppress interface transitions; users can explicitly resume.
